The eleven values above are the relations written into the Related IDs column. They are permanent properties of the two concepts and hold regardless of any document. The decision rules also use four from-text relations (attributed-to, exposed-to, benefits-from, engaged-in) that a tagger asserts when reading one piece of content; those are never written into the taxonomy and so are not listed here.
